justifications.read_only_justification: Returns only whether this connection is authenticated and which Ridian scopes it holds.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads nothing outside the current connection's own token.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes free start times; changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the workspace's own settings and the host's connected calendars.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns one booking; changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's Ridian workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns one lead and its history; changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's Ridian workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns an opaque profile id and the display name and sign-in email of the connected Ridian account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the signed-in Ridian profile; no calendar, task, contact or mail data and no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists absences of workspace members; changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's Ridian workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the workspace's appointment types; changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's Ridian workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists bookings in the workspace; changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's Ridian workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the workspace's funnels and lead counts; changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's Ridian workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists leads stored in the user's workspace; changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's Ridian workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds a note to a lead's history.
justifications.open_world_justification: The note stays inside the user's workspace; no one outside is notified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Purely additive: appends a note and does not change or remove existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Clears the booker's personal data from a booking.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only data in the user's workspace; no one is notified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Irreversibly removes personal data and the booker's manage link.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a booking, writes a calendar event and emails the booker.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends a confirmation email to the booker, a person outside the workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sends a confirmation email to the booker that cannot be recalled; the booking itself is additive and a repeated request_id returns the same booking.

justifications.read_only_justification: Cancels a booking and deletes its calendar event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Emails the booker, a person outside the workspace, about the cancellation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Irreversibly cancels the booking and deletes the calendar event.

justifications.read_only_justification: Records a new absence for a workspace member.
justifications.open_world_justification: The absence stays inside the workspace; no one outside is notified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Purely additive: records a new absence; existing bookings are not changed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new appointment type in the user's workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the user's Ridian workspace: it is saved as a draft, nothing is emailed, no calendar is written and the booking page is not public until the user activates it in Ridian.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new draft without changing or replacing any existing appointment type, booking or calendar.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an existing absence.
justifications.open_world_justification: The change stays inside the workspace; no one outside is notified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removes the absence record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Moves a booking to another host, creating and deleting calendar events.
justifications.open_world_justification: Emails the booker, a person outside the workspace, the new host and meeting link.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deletes the old host's event and overwrites the booking's host.

justifications.read_only_justification: Moves an existing booking and its calendar event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Emails the booker, a person outside the workspace, about the new time.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the booking's current time.

justifications.read_only_justification: Accepts or declines a pending booking request.
justifications.open_world_justification: Emails the booker, a person outside the workspace; accepting also writes the event to the host's calendar at the provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: The email to the booker cannot be recalled, and declining frees the requested time. Only pending requests are affected; a second call changes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists user-requested feedback and queues support delivery; requires feedback:write.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends to the fixed Ridian support inbox outside the user’s private workspace, including internal user/workspace routing references.
justifications.destructive_justification: Delivery cannot be recalled. A stable requestId prevents another feedback record but does not reverse sending.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sets an appointment type to active or paused.
justifications.open_world_justification: Activating publishes the booking page, which anyone with the link can then use to book.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the saved status; pausing stops new bookings on a page that was public. Setting the same status again changes nothing, but the overwrite is not additive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the status of a lead and records it in the history.
justifications.open_world_justification: The change stays inside the user's workspace; no one outside is notified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the current status of the lead.
